usedFor: 42min holds booked meetings and Sangam CRM holds your leads, so “New Booking” can start “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in 42min, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each booker lands in the CRM as a lead, and a repeat booker updates the existing one.

watchOut: Pairing “Updated Booking Time” with “Create Opportunity” would add a second opportunity whenever someone reschedules.
